def logistic_sigmoid_regression(X, y, w_init, alpha, tol = 1e-4, loop = 10000):

er logistic_sigmoid_regression(X, y, w_init, alpha, tol = re-
w = [w_init]
N = X.shape[1]
d = X.shape[0]
count = 0
check_w = 20
while count < loop:
    # mix data
    mix_id = np.random.permutation(N)
    for i in mix_id:
        xi = X[:, i].reshape(d, 1)
        yi = y[i]
        zi = sigmoid(np.dot(w[-1].T, xi))
        w_new = w[-1] + alpha*(yi - zi)*xi
        count += 1
        # stopping criteria
        if count%check_w == 0:
            if np.linalg.norm(w_new - w[-check_w]) < tol:
                return w
        w.append(w_new)
return w
